name: Reckoner
tagline: Every card you play is a target number; add or multiply the field to sweep it up.
core_loop: Play one card as a target number, then capture field cards that add or multiply to it (or trail the card), score target times cards taken, and re-roll the bounty die whenever a bounty rank cashes in.
win_condition: Highest score after all 48 hand cards are played; ties break on captured cards, then best single capture, then higher seat number.
